love.summary: Most readers this week sense hidden truths or unresolved tension surfacing in Capricorn's love life, so take an honest look at whether a current connection truly serves you and be willing to walk away from what no longer aligns with your values.
love.disagreement: Some readers focused on betrayal and hurt caused by a dishonest partner, while others emphasized empowerment and choosing to move on toward healthier connections.

finance.summary: Several readers sense financial imbalance this week, whether from unresolved grievances or careless habits, so Capricorn is encouraged to bring more mindfulness and discipline to money matters before things slip further out of balance.
finance.disagreement: Some readers focused on caution and loss, while one suggested an unexpected financial gain or returned funds may actually improve Capricorn's situation this week.

career.summary: Most readers see career momentum as something Capricorn must actively claim this week, whether by pushing past self-doubt, tuning out outside noise, or navigating workplace friction, with the shared advice being to trust your own direction and keep moving forward.
career.disagreement: Some readers saw disruption or conflict as the main challenge to navigate, while others suggested success comes simply from inner alignment and confidence, with little external friction implied.

family.summary: Only a few readers touched on family this week, but those who did pointed to meaningful moments around trust, security, and guidance, suggesting Capricorn focus on strengthening the bonds that provide a stable foundation.
family.disagreement: No notable disagreement among readers who discussed this theme.

overall_tone_summary: Powerful shifts are reshaping what Capricorn thought was already settled.
